approvals.reason: v2 adds a 'remember me' session that must survive the access token's own short expiry, which a bearer-gated refresh cannot do once that token has already expired.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The golden .NET host authenticates refresh_token with the same bearer token it is trying to renew, so refresh is only possible while the access token is still valid.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: refresh_token is unauthenticated at the bearer layer and instead reads a rotating secret from the HttpOnly yaginx-refresh cookie set at login, checked against a server-side account_session row with its own idle/absolute deadlines.

approvals.reason: Same cookie-based redesign as the success case: the failure mode is now 'no/invalid refresh cookie', not 'no/invalid Authorization bearer'.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The golden .NET host's refresh_token 401 fixture rejects a missing Authorization header.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: A missing, malformed, or expired/revoked yaginx-refresh cookie returns 401 and clears both auth cookies so the browser does not keep retrying a dead session.

approvals.reason: The legacy host generates an unobservable random verification code and has no SMTP sink configuration.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The golden host cannot complete the verification success path without external SMTP delivery.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: A deterministic isolated SMTP sink supplies the generated code and proves the successful Boolean envelope without external delivery.

approvals.reason: Reset requires the random code emitted by the preceding verification flow.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The golden host has no observable code source and its recovery row insertion is not repeatable without fixture cleanup.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: The isolated adapter provides the code and uses prefix-scoped data that is cleaned after the run; success returns the standard Boolean envelope.

approvals.reason: The legacy middleware throws before the controller executes.
approvals.dotnetObservation: Authenticated GET returns 500 with Sequence contains more than one matching element.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: The isolated controller adapter proves the documented successful SMTP settings envelope; production secrets remain redacted in evidence.

approvals.reason: The legacy middleware throws before the controller executes.
approvals.dotnetObservation: Authenticated POST returns 500 with Sequence contains more than one matching element.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: The isolated controller adapter proves the documented successful Boolean envelope without retaining SMTP credentials.

approvals.reason: The success path requires a reachable SMTP server and the controller is unreachable on the golden host.
approvals.dotnetObservation: Only the unauthenticated 401 fixture is observable on the current golden host.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: The isolated SMTP sink proves the documented successful Boolean envelope and retains no delivered message content.

approvals.reason: Management is intentionally isolated from public business listeners.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The golden .NET host maps AdminUI and management API into the business HTTP pipeline and has no health endpoint there.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: AdminUI, management API, health, and metrics bind only to the CIDR-restricted management listener; business listeners return 404 for /yaginx_console.

approvals.reason: v2 removes the anonymous .NET user_info action while retaining management API precedence over the SPA fallback.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The pre-v2 capture used a retired anonymous management action and cannot serve as v2 endpoint evidence.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: An unauthenticated v2 management API request returns 401 and never falls through to the AdminUI SPA.

approvals.reason: The .NET capture host does not expose its request-history classifier for a cancelled client stream.
approvals.dotnetObservation: No safe website-level capture input produced a durable cancelled-request history record.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: Cancelled request, response, and upgrade paths are classified as 601 without rewriting an already-started response.

approvals.reason: Immutable snapshot lifetime is a Go safety guarantee not observable from the legacy provider.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The .NET provider does not expose route-generation ownership for an in-flight connection.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: Each request retains one immutable snapshot and transport until completion; reload publishes only a fully validated candidate.

approvals.reason: Legacy request-history evidence is unavailable for a deliberately aborted fixture client.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The proxy host closes the request without an observable classified history record.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: Client cancellation is classified as 601 ClientCanceled for proxy metrics and in-memory events, but is intentionally suppressed from request-history persistence as high-frequency noise.

approvals.reason: The golden host has no safe short activity-timeout configuration for fixture capture.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The configured legacy timeout is too long for deterministic R0 capture.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: An expired upstream activity timeout is recorded as 602 UpstreamTimeout.

approvals.reason: The legacy provider falls through rather than surfacing a stable no-destination classifier.
approvals.dotnetObservation: No website-level input exposed an independent no-destination status.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: A selected route with no usable destination is recorded as 603 NoAvailableDestination.

approvals.reason: A controlled client upload failure cannot be retained as a complete legacy HTTP fixture.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The connection terminates before the golden host emits a stable client response.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: Client request-body read or upstream write failure is recorded as 607 UpstreamRequestBodyFailure.

approvals.reason: A client write failure is observable only after the client has disconnected.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The golden host cannot return an HTTP exchange to the already-disconnected fixture client.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: A response write failure after response start is recorded as 608 ClientWriteFailure without changing the client status.

approvals.reason: An unrecognised YARP transform removes the legacy route and returns 404 instead of exposing a pipeline exception.
approvals.dotnetObservation: No disposable website-level golden input produces ProxyPipelineException.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: A Go pipeline/configuration exception is classified as 609 ProxyPipelineException.

approvals.reason: The legacy host does not expose a stable catch-all error classifier.
approvals.dotnetObservation: Unhandled provider failures vary by middleware and do not map to one durable history status.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: Unclassifiable proxy failures are recorded as 610 UnknownProxyError.

approvals.reason: 9443 is deliberately TCP-only because PROXY Protocol is TCP-only.
approvals.dotnetObservation: Kestrel declares HTTP/3 but the legacy deployment behavior is unstable for this listener.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: 9443 accepts TCP HTTP/1.1/2 only and does not bind UDP/QUIC.

approvals.reason: Go makes ambiguous host normalization fail closed.
approvals.dotnetObservation: Legacy host normalization is inconsistent across provider paths.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: Host names are IDNA ASCII, lowercase, and trailing-dot normalized before conflict detection.

approvals.reason: Go refuses ambiguous route configuration instead of depending on provider precedence.
approvals.dotnetObservation: YARP may resolve conflicting configuration by precedence or dictionary overwrite.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: A conflicting candidate snapshot is rejected and the previous validated snapshot remains active.

approvals.reason: Go rejects a candidate with an unresolved route value rather than silently changing its path.
approvals.dotnetObservation: PathPattern /mapped/{**remainder} forwards as /mapped when the legacy route has no remainder value.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: The candidate snapshot is rejected and the current validated snapshot remains active.

approvals.reason: Go rejects a candidate with an unresolved route value rather than silently leaving the query unchanged.
approvals.dotnetObservation: QueryRouteParameter route Set remainder leaves the legacy query unchanged when remainder is absent.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: The candidate snapshot is rejected and the current validated snapshot remains active.

approvals.reason: Site maintenance mode is a new product capability without a legacy golden-host equivalent.
approvals.dotnetObservation: The legacy proxy has no site-level maintenance switch that returns a stable maintenance response before local and upstream processing.
approvals.targetGoBehavior: An enabled site returns the fixed 503 maintenance response before CORS, simple responses, redirects, routes, and upstream forwarding while ACME challenge handling remains available.
